audience: Mumbai housing-society committee members and facility managers
customerQuestion: What should a society receive from a professional fire AMC?

handoff.sourceOfTruth: This repository; no shared chat memory is assumed
handoff.fallback: Claude completes planning independently if Grok brief is unavailable

cta: DM AMC for a discussion about your building's maintenance needs

creativeStandard.format: 1080x1920,18-35s,meaningful visual motion,audible authorized audio,subtitles,original logo every frame
creativeStandard.prohibitedFallback: Plain gradient/text-card slideshow or silent AAC stream
creativeStandard.assets: Real authorized ASZ footage preferred; approved licensed or labelled AI illustrative media otherwise
creativeStandard.qa: Review actual first/middle/last and scene-boundary frames, cover, audio, provenance and date accuracy before publishing

reels.hook: What did your last AMC visit cover?
storyboard: Visual close-up of an anonymized service report with client data removed
Technician carrying out an authorized non-hazardous inspection
Relevant equipment detail with a short supporting caption
reels.narrationDirection: Explain the value of knowing what was inspected, what needs attention and what happens next. Do not imply paperwork alone proves safety.

reels.theme: A professional visit, behind the scenes
reels.hook: A service visit should leave clear answers.
storyboard: ASZ equipment or approved illustrative establishing shot
Authorized technician preparation and inspection footage
Detail shot relevant to the actual source footage
CTA to discuss society AMC needs
reels.narrationDirection: Describe only the tasks visible and verified in the source footage; no invented site/customer or procedural fire-safety instruction.

reels.hook: Comparing AMC quotes? Compare the scope.
storyboard: Image-led hook with real fire-system background
Anonymized example scope sheet clearly labelled illustrative
Equipment details matching the chosen services
Readable visual of visit schedule, reporting and exclusions
reels.narrationDirection: Encourage a clear written scope, visit schedule, reporting and exclusions. Do not invent prices, guarantees or legal requirements.

gbp.angle: Documented maintenance and clear service scope
gbp.imageBrief: Original authorized technician/equipment photograph with clean logo and restrained headline; no client identifiers

website.action: Review existing Fire AMC page for clearer scope, verified evidence and enquiry journey; prepare the top three exact changes and track implementation separately

measurement.hypothesis: A visual explanation of service documentation and scope will produce more qualified AMC enquiries than caption-card-only reels.
measurement.primary: Qualified enquiries by Instagram/GBP/website and campaign keyword
secondary: Search Console page/query clicks and impressions over comparable complete periods
GBP calls and website actions where available
measurement.rule: Do not invent unavailable metrics or equate WebSearch result order with Google ranking.
